Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; can you tell me your gestational age and if you had any complications during delivery?

REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas
REQUEST TEST: Chest_XRay

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Arterial_Blood_Gas: pH 7.30, PaCO2 50 mm Hg, PaO2 60 mm Hg, HCO3- 24 mEq/L, Base_Excess -5; Chest_XRay: Ground-glass appearance, air bronchograms, suggesting Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS)

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS). The arterial blood gas confirms respiratory acidosis and hypoxemia, and the chest X-ray findings of ground-glass opacities with air bronchograms are classic for surfactant deficiency in a preterm or stressed newborn.
